div.head: VII Atr 2.5
div.ab: Et sciat omnis presbiter et tungrauius et decimales homines, ut hec elemosina et ieiunium proueniat, sicut in sanctis iurare poterunt.
Et sciat omnis presbiter et tungravius et decimales homines, ut haec elemosina et ieiunium proveniat, sicut in sanctis iurare poterunt.
Et sciat omnis presbyter et tungravius et decimales homines, ut haec elemosina et ieiunium proveniat, sicut in sanctis iurare poterunt.
And every priest and the reeve of every village and the heads of the tithings shall be witnesses that this alms-giving and fasting is carried out, and shall be able to swear to it on the holy relics.
And let every priest, town reeve, and tithingman oversee the almsgiving and fasting, so that they can swear to it on holy relics.
Und jeder Pfarrer sei Zeuge und der Dorfvogt und die Zehntschaftsvorsteher, dass dies Almosen und Fasten zu Stande kommt, so wie sie auf die Heiligen[-Reliquien] werden beschwören können.
And let every priest and the village-reeve and the tithing-men witness that this alms and fast is carried out, so that they will be able to swear to it on the relics.
div.note: tithingman: The head of a tithing, an administrative unit consisting of one tenth of a hundred.
